description: Scan 1 to 10 public domains or http(s) URLs (for example an agency's client sites) for AI chat widgets and AI SDKs, and check each page for a visible EU AI Act Article 50(1) notice. Every entry is checked first: if any entry is localhost, a private or reserved IP or an internal host, the whole batch is refused and nothing is fetched. Returns the number of gaps, one row per host (HTTP status, widgets, SDKs, notice, gap), each host's report link and README status shield, a one-line badge.js fix for each gap, and links to the portfolio cockpit, Team (€79/mo) and Done-For-You (€199 once per site). At most 4 pages are fetched at once. Heuristic: reads the HTML of one page per domain. Not legal advice.

domains.description: 1 to 10 public http(s) URLs or bare domains, for example ["stepnetwork.dk", "folk.app"]. Duplicate hosts are scanned once.

format.description: Output format: `markdown` (default report + fixes) or `csv` (RFC 4180 CSV for Google Sheets, Excel, Vanta & agency spreadsheets).

name: spurvik_batch_scan_domains
